output:
I'll start by discovering the tickets MCP tools.

I wrote the report to `/app/report.json` and the status file to `/app/STATUS.json`, with status `success`. I read all 18 open P1 tickets across the 4 result pages and checked each ticket's comments. I didn't change, comment on or create any ticket. A final command re-read both files and they parsed as valid JSON.

| Team | Open P1 | Unanswered |
|---|---|---|
| billing | 3 | 211, 231 |
| data | 5 | 214, 219 |
| identity | 4 | 220 |
| mobile | 2 | 228 |
| platform | 4 | 217 |

A ticket counted as unanswered when its only comments came from its own customer, or when it had no comments. Tickets 211, 214 and 217 have only a "still happening" follow-up from the customer, so they are unanswered. Tickets 210, 222, 232 and 234 also have a customer follow-up but got a reply from staff, so they are answered.
